# *** THE PATTERN, as it stands after the correction above. *** Of the Lerena fathers in this drawer
# whose origin can be traced at all, EVERY ONE is Uruguayan or married in Uruguay. THREE branches,
# not four - Gilberto, Alejandro Maximo and Nemesio Ramon - settling in Entre Rios, Misiones and
# Buenos Aires, and one common origin across the river. Four more fathers are untraced. None of the
# three is Juan Carlos Lerena, and none is shown to be related to him.
# What it supports: not a link, but a BASE RATE. In this generation, an Argentine Lerena is a
# Uruguayan family's son far more often than not. Juan Carlos Lerena, who left no trace in the
# Rosario parish at all, fits that shape.
